description:
How I Met Your Mother is best known for its legendary cast, hilarious one-liners, and the long-running mystery of how Ted meets "the mother." But every once in a while, the show steps away from the laughs, and delivers a gut-punch of emotion that no one saw coming.  This shocking episode changed everything, not just for fans, but for the actor involved.
